main_binary.scope: Build and targeted main Go integration; the 40-case native matrix above ran the isolated clean-source binary

checks.full_go: Go 1.27.4 CGO=0 go test -p 2 ./...; PROWL_LIVE_TEST empty
owned_http_pipeline: publishable and legacy anon through JSON/JS/YAML/TOML
post-ML exact surviving publishable object; existing structural JWT exemption preserved
HEAD only, selected fixed table path, explicit public schema
unknown aliases/cross-object binding rejected before transport
response metadata and key not serialized
HEAD body never read and response closed
shared budget and credential-separated cache; inconclusive retry
checks.native: 40/40: 20 L1/ML format cases, 8 invalid configs, missing/two tables, 6 CLI preflight cases, SARIF/pretty, baseline preservation, opt-out

contract.keys: publishable or narrow legacy anon shape; key sent only as apikey header
contract.baseline: Audited observations are not suppressed by credential baseline or accepted as credential identities

limitations: No real Supabase account, key, RLS configuration or grants qualified
HEAD acceptance/empty response does not prove readable rows, disabled RLS or unintended disclosure
HTTP 403 is a request rejection, not a diagnosis of grants versus gateway versus RLS
Simple public schema table identifiers only; table/view distinction not inferred
No custom/self-hosted domains, XML/plist/dex/env bindings or cross-declaration/file joins
Strict legacy JWT subset; other headers/claims excluded without claims of safety
Server-side pre-request hooks/policies can execute during ordinary read requests
ML can drop non-exempt candidates; structural JWT exemption unchanged
No final images, installed-model migration, deployment or external release publication
